items.actionable_reason: The item's only evidence fact states that the initial prenatal assessment includes specified baseline blood and infection screening, without naming any constituent test or any gestational timing. Nothing in the package therefore distinguishes the keyed blood group and antibody screen from the group B streptococcus, glucose challenge and fetal fibronectin distractors. The author rationale supplies a specific six-test panel and specific screening windows that no cited source states.
items.secondary_observation: This is the only pilot item with four options rather than five; consider restoring option-count parity during re-authoring.
items.suggested_remedy: Research the PHAC prenatal guideline's Appendix B laboratory-screening table, already named in the existing source locator, and record the baseline panel composition and the timing of group B streptococcus and gestational diabetes screening as separate facts. The item can then be re-authored with a new question version and resubmitted for independent verification.
items.verifier_position_on_clinical_correctnes: The keyed option is very likely correct as a matter of Canadian obstetric practice. It is rejected on evidence entailment, not on medical content, in line with the repository rule against reconstructing missing source evidence from medical knowledge.
